{{Quote|Don't just dream about applying for the Academy, make it come true! You can find a career in space: Exploration, Starfleet, or Merchant Service. If you have the right stuff to take on the universe, dispatch your application and join the ranks of the proud!|Imperial Academy recruitment tape|<ref name="A Wind">{{SWRadio|A Wind to Shake the Stars}}</ref>}}
The '''Merchant Galactic'''<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> or '''Merchant Services'''<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> was a civilian auxiliary to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It specialized in military transportation and logistics, and was closely related to the [[Imperial Supply]] Fleet. Its primary training establishment was the [[Imperial Merchant Galactic Academy]] on [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]].<ref name="EGW" /> In large part because of its ties to the Imperial Navy branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the Imperial Merchant Galactic Academy on Rhinnal was part of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] system.<ref name="SWJ:tFfJ">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>
